name: 54729 · Chippewa Fls, WI
findings: ZIP 54729 (Chippewa Fls) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54729 (Chippewa Fls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
